name: ai-talk
description: AI Talk 将研发需求整理为最小 Task Contract，并标注真正影响实现的 Context Gap。
AI Talk builds execution protocols from user language, evidence, and code context for company Skills.

interface.shortDescription: 整理研发上下文并标注真正影响实现的缺口
interface.longDescription: AI Talk 保留用户原始目标和真实证据，识别会影响业务结果、修改范围或实现方向的 Context Gap，并生成最小 Task Contract 交给后续 Codex。它不搜索项目、不读取公司文档、不调用 Skill、不规划检索顺序，也不扩展业务需求。
interface.shortDescription: Build execution protocols for company Skills
interface.longDescription: AI Talk converts user language, screenshots, files, and code context into an execution protocol containing a normalized goal, confirmed context, required knowledge gaps, real constraints, optional assumptions, and a high-confidence next Skill. It stops after formatting and requires explicit follow-up authorization before execution.
